name: Full-Duplex-Bench-Data
description: A dataset for evaluating full‑duplex audio communication systems, focusing on metrics that matter for two‑way audio such as echo cancellation, latency, and perceived audio quality. It contains recordings and test scenarios designed to stress duplex channels and measure system robustness under realistic conditions (e.g., simultaneous transmit/receive, network impairments). Useful for benchmarking real‑time communication stacks and audio processing algorithms.
reputation: Relatively new and niche; limited adoption so far outside specialized real‑time audio research.
